lines.text: Cain farms and Abel keeps sheep, and the LORD favors Abel's offering of the best of his flock but not Cain's.
The LORD warns Cain that sin is crouching at his door, but Cain asks Abel to go out to the field and kills him.
Cain says he does not know where Abel is, and the LORD says Cain will be a servant to his father.
The LORD places a mark on Cain, who settles in the land of Goshen and builds a city named after his son Enoch.
Adam and Eve have a son named Seth, and when Seth's son Enosh is born, men begin to call upon the LORD.
